title: Filtering the categories table by text

steps.title: Keep rows where name is Argan Products
steps.prompt:
WHERE is a sieve: only rows that pass the test stay.
Text values wear quotes, like 'Argan Products'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM categories WHERE name = 'Argan Products';
hints: Wrap the text value in single quotes.
Write: SELECT * FROM categories WHERE name = 'Argan Products';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM categories WHERE name = 'Argan Products';

steps.title: Search with LIKE for names starting 'Arg'
steps.prompt:
LIKE searches by pattern using the % wildcard.
Arg% means 'starts with'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM categories WHERE name LIKE 'Arg%';
hints: Write: SELECT * FROM categories WHERE name LIKE 'Arg%';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM categories WHERE name LIKE 'Arg%';

steps.title: Search with LIKE for 'rga' anywhere
steps.prompt:
Putting % on BOTH sides matches the text anywhere.
This %rga% means 'contains'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM categories WHERE name LIKE '%rga%';
hints: Wrap the text in %% on both sides.
Write: SELECT * FROM categories WHERE name LIKE '%rga%';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM categories WHERE name LIKE '%rga%';
